# 1 Enoch Chapter 53 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Parables (Similitudes)

**53:1** [Verse 1 — Ge'ez text follows standard Ethiopic recension]

**53:2** [Verse 2 — Ge'ez text follows standard Ethiopic recension]

**53:4** [Verse 4 — Ge'ez text follows standard Ethiopic recension]

**53:6** [Verse 6 — Ge'ez text follows standard Ethiopic recension]

**53:7** [Verse 7 — Ge'ez text follows standard Ethiopic recension]


---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Bracketed words \[thus\] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text. Where 4QEn (Aramaic) fragments survive for this chapter, significant variants are noted.*
